results.title: Harrison County Commission moves forward on constructing pad for animal control facility
results.description: CLARKSBURG, W.Va. — Harrison County commissioners approved several measures to move forward construction at the former site of the Sunset Ellis Drive-in in Shinnston during their meeting on Wednesday.

results.title: YSRCP urges State Election Commission to defer municipal rolls until SIR completion
results.description: YSRCP urges the State Election Commission to delay municipal elections until the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls is completed.

results.title: Labour Ministry warns foreign managers over worker abuse
results.description: The Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training (MLVT) has warned that it will take strict action against foreign managers in the private sector who engage in inappropriate behaviour or use language that undermines the dignity of Cambodian workers.
